saba-02.caption: To start, tell me about a time you used data to change a product decision.

cand-01.caption: At Juniper Logistics, most late deliveries came from the date we promised at checkout. So I built a delivery-time model, and made the case for showing a delivery window instead. Late deliveries fell 18% in two quarters.

cand-01.0.caption: At Juniper Logistics, most late deliveries came from the date we promised at checkout.

cand-01.1.caption: So I built a delivery-time model, and made the case for showing a delivery window instead.

cand-01.2.caption: Late deliveries fell 18% in two quarters.

saba-03b.caption: When you made the case for a window, how did you convince the product team?

cand-02.caption: I ran a two-week test, split by city, with cancellations as the main metric. The numbers did the convincing.

saba-04b.caption: That's all from me today, and your review is ready now.
